svg.desc: Sequential text excerpt containing the title, 30 April 2013 Recommendation status, and opening PROV-O abstract sentences, followed by an editorial warning that provenance is not proof of truth.
svg.text: The PROV Ontology (PROV-O) expresses the PROV
Data Model [PROV-DM] using the OWL2 Web Ontology
set of classes, properties, and restrictions
that can be used to represent and interchange
CONTEXT LIMIT — Provenance representation is not
proof that a trace is true.
